name: Target Priority
text: While this model is part of a unit, that unit (an attached bodyguard included) may shoot and may declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Narthecium
text: While this model is leading a unit, once in each of your Command phases you may return one destroyed non-CHARACTER model to that unit, set up in coherency and clear of enemies. If there is no legal spot, nothing returns.

name: Close-quarters Firepower
text: Each ranged attack a model in this unit makes against the closest eligible target has its AP improved by 1.
